purpose: non-diagnostic wellbeing conversation; no clinical assessment or treatment

B02.objective: user-reported emotion at the described event

B05.objective: user-reported thoughts at the described event

B06.objective: recent frequency, without a severity score

B11.requires: explicit interest in steps or advice

transitions.suppliedInformation: Mark all confidently supplied objectives fulfilled, including negated emotional reports without assigning opposite sentiment.
transitions.nextObjective: First item in the selected order absent from asked, fulfilled, and skipped. B11 requires wantsSteps.
transitions.lowConfidence: C01 clarifies the active objective. Another uncertain answer skips that objective and offers C02 direction clarification. Repeated uncertainty then becomes L01 listening, never a loop of B questions.
transitions.topicChange: L01 invites the user to lead. Keep fulfilled/asked objectives; do not infer the new topic from history.
transitions.listenOnly: L01, with no advice/action questions. Explicit later interest in steps leaves listen-only mode.
transitions.skip: Skip the active or clarified objective; select the next eligible objective.
transitions.pause: P01 and existing pause lifecycle, preserving the interrupted objective.
transitions.finish: F01 and existing completion lifecycle. No mandatory reflection.
transitions.positive: B10 then optional B12, skipping problem exploration already unnecessary for a positive focus.
transitions.takeawayAnsweredOrExhausted: F01, then one analysis and one closing narration when consent and audio permit.

confidence.note: Routing scores are development heuristics, not calibrated probabilities.
